We would like to make data from our database available so that our users can generate statistics using AI. The MCP solves this problem. I initially set up my MCP locally on my machine in localhost, and everything worked very well. Now I’d like to host this MCP on an internal server at our company that’s accessible via a URL, and this is the part I’m having trouble understanding.
